title: Modernize frmcustomer to C#
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 form needs to be converted to C# while preserving functionality.
risk_if_unaddressed: Loss of functionality and inability to maintain the form.
suggested_approach: Use a C# WinForms template to recreate the form and ensure all event handlers are correctly mapped.
success_criteria: Form loads correctly in C# application.
All buttons and fields function as expected.
